text:
Jayden Struble was traded from Montreal to Nashville on Oct. 9 for a 2027 second-round pick, one day before his first game as a Predator. He has fit right in. He has three goals and four points in 18 games, already close to his 12 points in 59 games last season, and two of those goals have come in Nashville's recent winning run.

Our numbers call his form earned rather than lucky, at least for now: he's getting a bit more from his own shots (0.6 expected goals over his last ten, against a usual 0.4). That said, three goals on six shots is 50% shooting, so the scoring pace won't hold. His wins added (goals weighted by how much they swung the game) ranks 193rd of 521 skaters.

His game remains physical. He has 45 hits and 23 blocks in about 15 minutes a night. The weak spot is the same one Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flagged last season: only 24% of his exits keep possession. Watch how he handles the forecheck.
headline: Struble's hot streak looks earned
